Problem illustrated: Compromise of the software production process
Relevant security practices: Protected builds, controlled changes, provenance checks, separate release approval
Main lesson: A trusted release channel or valid signature does not prove harmless content

Problem illustrated: Helper code can access sensitive build information
Relevant security practices: Controlled inputs, isolated execution, limited permissions, integrity checks
Main lesson: The source of helper code and its execution permissions both matter

Problem illustrated: A vulnerable genuine component remains in deployed software
Relevant security practices: Component inventories, advisory monitoring, updates, containment
Main lesson: Finding affected software is useful only when it leads to an effective response
